headline: Trabzonspor vs Beşiktaş: a derby the market can't split
summary: The market reads this derby as a genuine near coin-flip: Trabzonspor at 38.1%, the draw at 24.9% and Beşiktaş at 37.1%, with the level handicap sitting at 50.6/49.4. The sharp book has shortened Over 3.25 to 46.9%, while the consensus is flat at 45.9% on just five books quoting the line, and the fair total has ticked from 3.03 to 3.13. BTTS Yes sits at 64.6%. The drift toward the home side was started by the soft books and only followed by the sharp market, so it reads as books converging rather than fresh information. All six injury-list players, Onuachu among them, predate our first list at 00:55 and show no readable price reaction.
